thread:
Maria (CS): Hey team — customer ACME reports users losing access after SSO provisioning. User created via SCIM but roles missing; ~10min later roles removed and user flagged deprovisioned. Happened to 3 users overnight. Ticket #12345.

Alex J (SE): Can you paste the SCIM logs + errors? Which IdP?

Maria (CS): Okta. Snippet:
```http
PATCH /v2/Users/00u1abcd123/groups HTTP/1.1
Host: scim.redwood.example
Authorization: Bearer eyJ... (expired)
Content-Type: application/json

{"Operations":[{"op":"add","value":[{"value":"00g1group","display":"prod-users"}]}]}
```
Response:
```json
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
{"error":"invalid_token","error_description":"The access token expired"}
```

Cleo (Support): We see the 401 on group assign, explains missing role. But why deprovision later?

Sam (Oncall): Our deprovisioner compares live group membership every 5m. If SCIM PATCH fails and no role assigned, deprovisioner treats user as external->absent -> removes roles. Looks like there's no retry on 401.

okta-bot: Token refresh attempt failed: refresh_token revoked for client_id=redwood-scim-prod (event id: evt-789).

Alex J (SE): Reproduced in staging:
1) Trigger Okta-provision (SSO)
2) SCIM client sends PATCH with expired token -> 401
3) scim_worker logs warn and skips retry:
```py
res = scim_client.patch_groups(uid, ops)
if res.status != 200:
    logger.warn('scim patch failed', status=res.status)
    # no further action
```
4) deprovisioner run (5m window) marks user inactive.

curl example:
```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <expired>" https://scim.redwood.example/v2/Users/00u1abcd123
HTTP/1.1 401 {"active":false, "error":"invalid_token"}
```

Cleo (Support): Customer workaround deployed: manual role reassign + disabled org-level deprovisioner for acme-corp. Also rotated Okta client secret per security advice.

Sam (Oncall): Root causes: (1) refresh flow doesn't handle revoked refresh token (no alert), (2) deprovisioner too aggressive for fresh accounts, (3) group->role mapper uses displayName only which is brittle to whitespace/case.

Alex J (SE): Fix plan:
- Add retry with token refresh/backoff for 401 responses. If refresh returns 400/revoked -> surface alert and pause deprovisioner for that org.
- Add 30m grace window in deprovisioner for newly created users/changed groups.
- Update mapper to prefer group.externalId (Okta group id) and normalize displayName as fallback.
- Add integration test for expired token -> eventual success path.

Maria (CS): Customer accepts temporary disable of deprovisioner. They want ETA for hotfix.

Sam (Oncall): Hotfix (retry + 30m grace) ETA 48h. Full credential rotation & mapper change 5 business days. I'll make RFC and coordinate with Security & CS.

Cleo (Support): Manual remediation steps we executed:
1) Reassign 'product-user' role to affected users
2) Flip org flag: deprovisioner.enabled=false for org acme-corp
3) Rotate Okta app secret and update scim-bridge secrets

okta-bot: Okta event: refresh_token.revoke by admin@acme.com at 2026-03-14T22:34:12Z

Alex J (SE): Pushed staging patch with unit tests. Need CS to have customer re-login and verify roles stick.

Maria (CS): I'll coordinate re-test tonight and update ticket #12345. Thanks all :thumbsup:
